notes: «وغير واحد» is an unnamed link (rule 8), kept in its place at the first level
«أن عمر، كان يقول» relays Umar's own ruling, so Umar is the last link of this saying
«حتى أخبره الضحاك بن سفيان الكلابي أن رسول الله ... كتب إليه» is a second saying with its own transmitter; no route is written for it: needs ruling (rule 11)
